_readme: SAMPLE rubrics written for this site. They are the instructor's criteria, kept separate from textbook content. Weights are percentages and should total 100. Students use these for SELF-assessment only; nothing is submitted or graded by this site.

criteria.name: Story structure
criteria.description: Clear beginning, conflict, turning point, and resolution.

criteria.name: Significance
criteria.description: The meaning of the story is clear and connects to the audience.

criteria.name: Detail and language
criteria.description: Specific, vivid details chosen with purpose.

criteria.name: Vocal delivery
criteria.description: Variety in pitch and pace; purposeful pauses; few vocalized fillers.

criteria.name: Physical delivery
criteria.description: Eye contact, posture, and natural gestures.

criteria.name: Time
criteria.description: Within the assigned time range.

criteria.name: Purpose and central idea
criteria.description: Specific purpose and central idea are clear and appropriately focused.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: Appropriate pattern, clear main points, effective connectives.

criteria.name: Research and citation
criteria.description: Credible sources, accurately represented and cited out loud.

criteria.name: Introduction and conclusion
criteria.description: All five introduction elements and three conclusion elements.

criteria.name: Presentation aid
criteria.description: Clear, readable, and improves understanding.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.description: Extemporaneous, conversational, with eye contact and vocal variety.

criteria.name: Time
criteria.description: Within the assigned time range.

criteria.name: Proposition and audience adaptation
criteria.description: Clear claim suited to where the audience stands.

criteria.name: Evidence and reasoning
criteria.description: Credible evidence with explained reasoning; free of fallacies.

criteria.name: Counterargument
criteria.description: Opposing view stated fairly and answered.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: Persuasive pattern fits the proposition.

criteria.name: Appeals and ethics
criteria.description: Balanced, honest use of ethos, pathos, and logos.

criteria.name: Call to action
criteria.description: Specific and doable.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.description: Confident, conversational, and engaging.

criteria.name: Time
criteria.description: Within the assigned time range.

criteria.name: Fit to occasion
criteria.description: Content and length match the occasion and audience expectations.

criteria.name: Tone
criteria.description: Tone is appropriate and consistent.

criteria.name: Language
criteria.description: At least one memorable, purposeful language technique.

criteria.name: Specific details
criteria.description: True, specific details about the subject.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.description: Sincere, steady, and well-paced.

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Introduction, body, and conclusion with a unifying theme.

criteria.name: Details
criteria.description: Specific rather than general.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.description: Eye contact and steady pace.

criteria.name: Clarity of steps
criteria.description: Logical stages the audience could repeat.

criteria.name: Use of materials
criteria.description: Visible, safe, and well-handled.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.description: Explains clearly while demonstrating.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: Clear point, support, and close.

criteria.name: Composure
criteria.description: Steady delivery under time pressure.

criteria.name: Unity
criteria.description: One central idea and consistent design.

criteria.name: Transitions
criteria.description: Planned, smooth handoffs.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: Accurate, well-supported information.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.description: Each member speaks clearly and engages the audience.

criteria.name: Research
criteria.description: Academic sources accurately cited in the assigned style.

criteria.name: Organization and reasoning
criteria.description: Clear structure and sound reasoning.

criteria.name: Rhetorical rationale
criteria.description: Choices are explained with course concepts.

criteria.name: Delivery and aids
criteria.description: Polished extemporaneous delivery with purposeful aids.

criteria.name: Reflection
criteria.description: Evidence-based reflection on growth.
